title: Deploy Platform Manifest v1
description: Contract for a deployable application. Describes source layout, build settings, deploy target, database migrations, and per-environment overrides.
$comment: source.layout is intentionally absent — the platform derives behavior from buildRoot and appRoot only.

$schema.description: Path to the JSON schema file

name.description: Unique, lowercase, hyphenated application identifier used in deployment artifact names.

buildRoot.description: Working directory for install/build commands. For a monorepo workspace this is the repo root '.'; for a single-app repo it is also '.'. Change only if install must run from a subdirectory.

appRoot.description: Optional. Path to the app inside the repo (relative to repo root). When set, the deploy artifact is staged from <appRoot>/<build.outputPath>. Omit for repos where the build output is directly under buildRoot.

workspacePackages.description: Optional. Glob pattern for npm workspace packages (e.g. 'packages/*'). Informational — used by the build command, not by the platform directly.

runtime.description: Runtime language. v1 supports node only.

bundleIncludes.description: Additional directories to include in the deploy bundle (e.g. ['prisma']).

platform.description: Deploy target. gae = Google App Engine (backend), firebase = Firebase Hosting (frontend).

configTemplate.description: Path to app.yaml.tpl (GAE) or firebase.json template. Relative to repo root.

serviceKey.description: Key within environments[env] that holds the GAE service name override.

migrate.description: Whether to run a migration step before deploy. Migration must succeed before GAE traffic promotion.

path.description: HTTP path to poll after deployment.

environments.description: Per-environment overrides keyed by logical environment name (stage, prod, etc.).

deploySecrets.description: Optional Doppler secret integration for this application.

provider.description: Secret provider. 'none' = rely on GitHub Environment secrets only. 'doppler' = activate Doppler CLI integration.

project.description: Doppler project name (required when provider is doppler).

bundleCli.description: Bundle the Doppler CLI into the deploy artifact so the GAE container can pull secrets at startup via start.sh.

config.description: Doppler config name for this environment (e.g. 'stage_api', 'prod_api').

environmentBlock.description: Per-environment configuration block. Additional keys (e.g. gaeService) are application-specific and referenced via deploy.serviceKey.

sourceRef.description: Git branch or tag to deploy from (e.g. 'stage', 'main', 'v1.2.3'). 'latest' triggers auto-resolution.

healthCheckUrl.description: Full URL to health-check endpoint for this environment.
